title: [Exhaust] ability targets units instead of "another gear".
expected: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-resources.ts:191-210 (parseEmpowerEffect) matches "another gear" but routes it to parseCardTarget (parser/impl/targets.ts:13-27), which hardcodes `{ type: "unit" }` and never inspects "gear" or "another" (no excludeSelf). Running parseAbilities on Hextech Formula's rulesText yields activated effect `{target:{type:"unit"}, type:"empower"}`, so the engine targets units, rejects gear, and empower.ts sets meta.empowered on the chosen unit. ven.json has abilities:[null], so the runtime parser output is what is used.
observed: Enumerated activateAbility (abilityIndex 1) offered only targets:[Gem Jammer] (a unit); forcing targets:[Seal of Discord] was rejected with CONDITION_FAILED. Chain item effect was {type:'empower', target:{type:'unit'}} and on resolution the unit Gem Jammer got meta.empowered=true while the Seal gear was untouched. parseAbilities yields effect.target {type:'unit'} for 'Empower another gear'.
